label: Some actual CONCRETE_6 individual is contingent and has no actual CONCRETE_6 ground
paraphrase: Rival framework commitment, unattributed (motivated by brute-fact views of contingent reality; existential inertia, as Schmid states it, denies concurrent sustenance and is not this rival): some concrete candidate exists at w, has no concrete ground existing at w under the selected relation at w, and is absent from some world accessible from w. An abstract, absent or unmodelled explanation is not excluded.
